# IStargateStaking
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/stargate/IStargateStaking.sol)

**Title:**
IStargateStaking

The interface to the staking contract for Stargate V2 LPs.


## Functions
### setPool

ADMIN *

Configures the rewarder for a pool. This will initialize the pool if it does not exist yet,
whitelisting it for deposits.


```solidity
function setPool(IERC20 token, IRewarder rewarder) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token of the pool|
|`rewarder`|`IRewarder`|The rewarder to configure for the pool|


### deposit

USER *

Deposits `amount` of `token` into the pool. Informs the rewarder of the deposit, triggering a harvest.


```solidity
function deposit(IERC20 token, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token to deposit|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount to deposit|


### depositTo

Deposits `amount` of `token` into the pool for `to`. Informs the rewarder of the deposit, triggering a
harvest. This function can only be called by a contract, as to prevent phishing by a malicious contract.

This function is useful for zappers, as it allows to do multiple steps ending with a deposit,
without the need to do multiple transactions.


```solidity
function depositTo(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token to deposit|
|`to`|`address`|The account credited with the deposit|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount to deposit|


### withdraw

Withdraws `amount` of `token` from the pool. Informs the rewarder of the withdrawal, triggers a harvest.


```solidity
function withdraw(IERC20 token, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token to withdraw|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount to withdraw|


### withdrawToAndCall

Withdraws `amount` of `token` from the pool for `to`, and subsequently calls the receipt function on the
`to` contract. Informs the rewarder of the withdrawal, triggering a harvest.

This function is useful for zappers, as it allows to do multiple steps ending with a deposit,
without the need to do multiple transactions.


```solidity
function withdrawToAndCall(IERC20 token, IStakingReceiver to, uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token to withdraw|
|`to`|`IStakingReceiver`|The receiver contract that the tokens are sent to and whose receipt function is called|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount to withdraw|
|`data`|`bytes`|Arbitrary data forwarded to the receiver's receipt function|


### emergencyWithdraw

Withdraws `amount` of `token` from the pool in an always-working fashion. The rewarder is not informed.


```solidity
function emergencyWithdraw(IERC20 token) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token to withdraw|


### claim

Claims the rewards from the rewarder, and sends them to the caller.


```solidity
function claim(IERC20[] calldata lpTokens) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`lpTokens`|`IERC20[]`|The staking tokens whose pools' rewards are claimed|


### balanceOf

VIEW *

Returns the deposited balance of `user` in the pool of `token`.


```solidity
function balanceOf(IERC20 token, address user) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token of the pool|
|`user`|`address`|The account whose balance is queried|


### totalSupply

Returns the total supply of the pool of `token`.


```solidity
function totalSupply(IERC20 token) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token of the pool|


### isPool

Returns whether `token` is a pool.


```solidity
function isPool(IERC20 token) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token to check|


### tokensLength

Returns the number of pools.


```solidity
function tokensLength() external view returns (uint256);
```

### tokens

Returns the list of pools, by their staking tokens.


```solidity
function tokens() external view returns (IERC20[] memory);
```

### tokens

Returns a slice of the list of pools, by their staking tokens.


```solidity
function tokens(uint256 start, uint256 end) external view returns (IERC20[] memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`start`|`uint256`|The start index of the slice (inclusive)|
|`end`|`uint256`|The end index of the slice (exclusive)|


### rewarder

Returns the rewarder of the pool of `token`, responsible for distribution reward tokens.


```solidity
function rewarder(IERC20 token) external view returns (IRewarder);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token of the pool|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`IRewarder`|The rewarder configured for the pool|


## Events
### Deposit
Emitted when tokens are deposited into a pool


```solidity
event Deposit(IERC20 indexed token, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token deposited|
|`from`|`address`|The address the tokens were pulled from|
|`to`|`address`|The account credited with the deposit|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount deposited|

### Withdraw
Emitted when tokens are withdrawn from a pool


```solidity
event Withdraw(IERC20 indexed token, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, bool withUpdate);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token withdrawn|
|`from`|`address`|The account the tokens were withdrawn from|
|`to`|`address`|The recipient of the withdrawn tokens|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount withdrawn|
|`withUpdate`|`bool`|Whether the rewarder was informed (harvested) during the withdrawal|

### PoolSet
Emitted when a pool's rewarder configuration is set


```solidity
event PoolSet(IERC20 indexed token, IRewarder rewarder, bool exists);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token of the pool|
|`rewarder`|`IRewarder`|The rewarder configured for the pool|
|`exists`|`bool`|Whether the pool exists after the update|

## Errors
### StargateStakingRenounceOwnershipDisabled
StargateStaking renounce ownership is disabled.


```solidity
error StargateStakingRenounceOwnershipDisabled();
```

### InvalidCaller
Thrown on `depositTo` if the caller does not have bytecode, used as an anti-phishing measure to prevent
users from calling `depositTo` as it's for zappers.


```solidity
error InvalidCaller();
```

### InvalidReceiver
Thrown on `withdrawToAndCall` if the `to` contract does not return the magic bytes.


```solidity
error InvalidReceiver(address receiver);
```

### NonExistentPool
Thrown when the referenced pool (staking token) does not exist


```solidity
error NonExistentPool(IERC20 token);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token with no configured pool|
